tools.name: woffu_list_users
tools.description: List the users of the Woffu company. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/users. No paging parameter is sent.

tools.name: woffu_get_user
tools.description: Get one user by UserId: name, company, department and status fields as Woffu returns them. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/users/{userId}.

tools.name: woffu_list_user_contracts
tools.description: List the employment contracts of one user by UserId. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/users/{userId}/contracts.

tools.name: woffu_list_departments
tools.description: List the departments of the Woffu company. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/departments.

tools.name: woffu_list_offices
tools.description: List the offices (work centres) of the Woffu company. Woffu API: GET /api/v1/offices.
